newsitem.title: USA: Lucor completes move to North Carolina.
newsitem.headline: Lucor completes move to North Carolina.

text.p: Lucor Inc on Monday said it completed the relocation of its corporate headquarters to Raleigh, North Carolina, from Boca Raton, Florida.
Lucor, which employs 1,200 people, is a franchisee of Jiffy Lube International.
It operates a chain of automotive fast oil change, fluid maintenance and lubrication centers in North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Kentucky, Tennessee and Michigan.
